name: @fjellrute/web
//: The browser planner: Vite + React + Leaflet + MapLibre. It is a workspace package so that the phone app added in Phase 2 can depend on the same @fjellrute/core without inheriting any of the dependencies below — leaflet and maplibre-gl mean nothing on React Native, and a single flat package.json is how they would end up in the phone app's install graph anyway. Note there is no `outDir` here: vite writes to ../../dist, because wrangler.jsonc at the repository root serves `dist` as its asset directory and the deploy path is deliberately unchanged by this move.
